name: Falsification Sampler

falsification_sample.description: VariableCollection with dependent and independent variable metadata.

falsification_sample.description: Number of samples to select that may falsify the model.

falsification_sample.description: Number of epochs to train the Popper network for error approximation.

falsification_sample.name: training_lr
falsification_sample.description: Learning rate for training the Popper network.

falsification_sample.name: plot
falsification_sample.description: Whether to display Popper network predictions and training loss.
